name: Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Mississippi Methodist Rehab Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospitals; Methodist Hospitals of Memphis has the most, 7,676. About 19.4 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospitals; Methodist Hospitals of Memphis has the most, 7,676. About 5.7 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Methodist Hospitals of Memphis have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospital reports more; Mississippi Methodist Rehab Center is next at 600. About 5.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Methodist Hospitals of Memphis in 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: One of its hospitals reports residents; Methodist Hospitals of Memphis trains the most, 241.

questions.q: What percent of Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 24 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 19 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Methodist Hospitals of Memphis's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicare was 16 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 24 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 17 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Methodist Hospitals of Memphis's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Traditional Medicaid was 6 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 25 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Mississippi Methodist Rehab Center report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospitals; Methodist Hospitals of Memphis has the most, 1,368 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospitals; Methodist Hospitals of Memphis has the most, 1,368 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Methodist Hospitals of Memphis report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: No other Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospital reports more; Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital is next at 73 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That is 16 percent of its 73 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Methodist Hospitals of Memphis report to Medicare for 2024?
questions.why: That is 31 percent of its 1,368 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital report for 2024?
questions.why: About 12 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Methodist Hospitals of Memphis report for 2024?
questions.why: About 139 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital in 2024?
questions.why: Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Methodist Hospitals of Memphis in 2024?
questions.why: Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.

questions.q: On an average day in 2024, what percent of Methodist Hospitals of Memphis's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: Mississippi 2 and Tennessee 1. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: In how many states does Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare run a hospital, by the federal list?
questions.why: Mississippi and Tennessee.

questions.q: How many Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospitals are in Mississippi, by the federal list?
questions.why: That is 2 of the 108 hospitals in Mississippi on CMS's list.

questions.q: How many Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare hospitals are in Tennessee, by the federal list?
questions.why: That is 1 of the 122 hospitals in Tennessee on CMS's list.

questions.q: How many beds do Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many beds does Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Methodist Hospitals of Memphis. Methodist Healthcare - Olive Branch Hospital is next, with 73.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 30 percent of their 1,472 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 151 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.
